summary: Clearway kerb on a busy arterial, with bush behind and no room to pull off.
reasons: No verge, bush against the kerb

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush behind the kerb and rail beyond the road, with no dwellings nearby; the van would still be in view of passing traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Bush runs right up to the kerb with no verge or pull-off, and the 25 m stretch sits beside a signalled junction.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial beside the rail line; heavy traffic and noise.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the kerb; the Clearway sign shows stopping is restricted.

flags: Low-lying: 8.3 m elevation, Toowong Creek 7 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the north side of the kerb.
cannot_judge: Whether the bush behind the kerb hides a usable pull-off
